english.title: Issuing body of equine ID fail to notify Secretary of State of loss of blank stock
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an issuing body that held or maintained

(A)_[an equine ID which was]_
(B)_[equine IDs which were]_
(C)_[pre-printed blank stock which was]_

lost, missing or stolen, failed to notify the Secretary of State as soon as possible of the loss, misplacement or theft; and with that notification, inform the Secretary of State of the circumstances of the loss, misplacement or theft and the serial numbers for the ID or the pre-printed blank stock concerned in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(4), 24(3) and 36 of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
issuing body
failed to ensure

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 37(1) provides that an enforcing authority may impose a civil sanction, or a combination of civil sanctions, under Part 6 against a person if the authority is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person is guilty of this offence.
(ii) Regulation 37(2) provides that criminal proceedings may not be started or continued against a person if any enforcing authority, in respect of the offence, chooses to apply civil sanctions and services a compliance notice, non-compliance penalty notice or fixed monetary penalty notice on that person.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
